# Agentheon

> A pantheon of Greek-deity software-engineering agents. Hermes orchestrates;
> each specialist owns exactly one domain and hands off along defined routes,
> advancing only through PASS/FAIL quality gates.

Agentheon is an open-source agentic agency: a curated roster of specialist AI
agent profiles — each a god of its domain — that drop into your agent runtime.
Every agent is a single Markdown profile (role, domain, tools, system prompt).

License: Apache 2.0
Source: https://github.com/nlamirault/agentheon
Language: English

## Markdown for agents

Every page supports content negotiation. Send `Accept: text/markdown` to any
URL and the edge Worker returns a clean Markdown rendering instead of HTML —
for example the home page or any agent page below.

## The Pantheon

Each agent page lives at `/agents/<name>/`.

- Hermes — The Orchestrator — Routing & Coordination (the sole entrypoint)
- Athena — The Strategist — Architecture & Planning
- Hephaestus — The Builder — Implementation
- Apollo — The Chronicler — Documentation & Knowledge
- Artemis — The Hunter — Testing & QA
- Argus — The Watcher — Security & Review
- Hestia — The Keeper — DevOps & Infrastructure
- Asclepius — The Healer — Debugging & Incident Response
- Demeter — The Cultivator — Data & Database Engineering
- Prometheus — The Forethinker — AI & ML Engineering
- Aphrodite — The Aesthete — Frontend & UX
- Aglaea — The Adornment — Design & Design Systems
- Kairos — The Opportune — Product & Prioritization
- Themis — The Arbiter — Compliance & Governance
- Helios — The All-Seeing — Observability & SRE
- Hygieia — The Purifier — Code Health & Refactoring
- Iris — The Messenger — Open Source & Community

## How it works

- Hermes is the single orchestrator (see ADR-0001): it routes every request and
  never does specialist work; specialists execute and hand off along their
  declared `handoffs` edges.
- Work advances through a plan → build → test → review → comply loop, gated by
  explicit PASS/FAIL checks.

## Pages

- / — Home
- /agents/<name>/ — one page per agent profile
